column4: 他的好成绩带动了其他同学努力学习。
column5: His good grades spurred the other students on to study hard.
column6: 带动 is when one person or thing makes others move or grow: 带动大家 (to spur everyone on), 带动经济 (to drive the economy).

column3: to replace; to take the place of
column4: 没有人能代替你。
column5: No one can replace you.
column6: 代替 is to take the place of a person or thing. 用 A 代替 B means "use A instead of B".

column4: 这家公司的待遇很好。
column5: The pay and benefits at this company are very good.
column6: 待遇 is how a company or a place treats you: pay, holidays and other benefits. It can also mean treatment in general (平等待遇).

column4: 他一个人住，还是单身。
column5: He lives alone and is still single.
column6: 单 means "single" or "only one" (单身, 单词) and also a list or bill (菜单). It is read dān here.

column4: 我想单独和你谈一谈。
column5: I would like to talk with you alone.
column6: 单独 means by oneself or apart from the others: 单独去, 单独住. It comes before the verb.

column3: to hold the post of; to serve as
column4: 他担任我们的汉语老师。
column5: He serves as our Chinese teacher.
column6: 担任 is followed by a job or position: 担任经理, 担任老师. It is formal.

column4: 他的生活很单一，每天只有工作。
column5: His life is very monotonous; every day is only work.
column6: 单一 describes something with only one kind or one element, often not enough variety: 饮食单一 (a monotonous diet).

column4: 这本书一共有十个单元。
column5: This book has ten units altogether.
column6: 单元 is a unit of a textbook (第一单元) and also an entrance section of an apartment block (二单元).

column4: 这个孩子很胆小，不敢一个人睡。
column5: This child is very timid and does not dare to sleep alone.
column6: 胆小 describes someone who is easily scared. Its opposite is 大胆 (bold).

column4: 这个汤太淡了，再放一点盐。
column5: This soup is too bland; add a little more salt.
column6: 淡 is the opposite of 咸 (salty) for taste and of "strong" for colour or tea: 淡茶 (weak tea).

column4: 我们请了一位当地人做导游。
column5: We invited a local person to be our guide.
column6: 当地 is the place being talked about: 当地人 (a local), 当地时间 (local time).

column4: 当年这里只是一个小村子。
column5: In those days this was only a small village.
column6: 当年 looks back to a time in the past: 当年的朋友 (friends of those days).

column4: 当前最重要的是休息。
column5: The most important thing at present is to rest.
column6: 当前 is the present moment or situation. Before a noun it means "current": 当前的问题.

column4: 这些学生当中，他的汉语最好。
column5: Among these students, his Chinese is the best.
column6: 当中 comes after a group of people or things: 同学当中, 朋友当中.

column4: 前面的车挡住了我们的路。
column5: The car in front blocked our way.
column6: 挡 is to stand in the way of something or keep it out: 挡雨 (keep out the rain), 挡住路 (block the road).

column3: to treat as; to take for
column4: 他把我当成了自己的弟弟。
column5: He took me for his own younger brother.
column6: 当成 is read dàngchéng; 当 is read dàng here, not dāng. 把 A 当成 B means "to treat A as B" or "to mistake A for B".

column3: to regard as; to treat as
column4: 他把这里当作自己的家。
column5: He treats this place as his own home.
column6: 当作 is read dàngzuò and means the same as 当成: 把 A 当作 B.

column4: 这个导演拍了很多好电影。
column5: This director has made many good films.
column6: 导演 is the director of a film, play or TV show. It is also a verb, "to direct".

column4: 大雨导致了很多问题。
column5: The heavy rain led to many problems.
column6: 导致 usually introduces a bad result: 导致事故 (to cause an accident).

column4: 火车明天上午九点到达这个城市。
column5: The train will arrive in this city at nine tomorrow morning.
column6: 到达 is a formal word for 到. It takes the place directly: 到达机场 (arrive at the airport).

column4: 他说得很有道理。
column5: What he says makes a lot of sense.
column6: 道理 is the reason behind something. 有道理 means "makes sense"; 没有道理 means "does not make sense".

column4: 我的护照下个月到期。
column5: My passport expires next month.
column6: 到期 is a verb plus object: it is for things that run out on a date, such as a passport, a card or a loan.

column4: 他每个周末都去登山。
column5: He goes mountain climbing every weekend.
column6: 登 is to go up to a high place: 登山 (to climb a mountain), 登上 (to climb up onto). It is also part of 登记 and 登录.

column4: 房间里的灯光很温暖。
column5: The light in the room is very warm.
column6: 灯光 is the light that lamps give off. Light from the sun is 阳光.

column4: 请先在这里登记一下。
column5: Please register here first.
column6: 登记 is to write your name or details in a record, for example at a hotel.

column4: 请用手机号码登录。
column5: Please log in with your phone number.
column6: 登录 is to log in to a website or an app. Its opposite is 退出 (to log out).

column4: 我们在等待比赛的结果。
column5: We are waiting for the result of the match.
column6: 等待 is a more formal word than 等. It often goes with something important or long: 等待结果.

column4: 请在这里等候，经理马上来。
column5: Please wait here; the manager will come right away.
column6: 等候 sounds polite and is used in signs and in requests to guests.

column3: to equal; to be the same as
column4: 三加四等于七。
column5: Three plus four equals seven.
column6: 等于 is used in maths and also in general: 不去就等于放弃 (not going is the same as giving up).

column4: 他低头看了看手机。
column5: He lowered his head and looked at his phone.
column6: 低头 is a verb plus object, so it can split: 低下头. Its opposite is 抬头 (to raise one's head).

column4: 他的确是个好老师。
column5: He really is a good teacher.
column6: 的确 confirms that something is true. 的 is read dí in this word, not de.

column4: 他没有敌人，大家都是他的朋友。
column5: He has no enemies; everyone is his friend.
column6: 敌人 is a person or a group you fight against. Its opposite is 朋友.

column4: 请把那本书递给我。
column5: Please pass me that book.
column6: 递 is to hand something to someone: 递给, 递过来 (to pass it over to me).

column4: 我最喜欢上地理课。
column5: I like geography class best.
column6: 地理 is geography as a school subject. It can also mean the natural features of a place: 地理位置 (geographical position).

column4: 地面太脏了，需要打扫。
column5: The ground is too dirty and needs sweeping.
column6: 地面 is the surface of the ground or the floor. 地上 means "on the ground".

column4: 这个地区的冬天很冷。
column5: The winters in this region are very cold.
column6: 地区 is an area larger than a town, such as a part of a country: 北方地区.

column4: 老师在社会上有很高的地位。
column5: Teachers have a high status in society.
column6: 地位 is the position of a person or country in society or in the world: 社会地位 (social status).

column4: 地下一层有一家超市。
column5: There is a supermarket on the first floor underground.
column6: 地下 means below the ground: 地下室 (basement), 地下停车场 (underground car park).

column4: 昨天晚上这里发生了地震。
column5: An earthquake happened here last night.
column6: 地震 is a noun and also a verb plus object ("the earth shakes"). 发生地震 means "an earthquake happens".

column4: 这家店的点心又好看又好吃。
column5: The pastries of this shop look nice and taste good.
column6: 点心 is read diǎnxin. It is light food such as cakes and pastries, eaten between meals.

column3: to like (on a phone or online)
column4: 很多人给他的照片点赞。
column5: Many people give his photo a like.
column6: 点赞 is to tap the thumbs-up on a post. In speech 给你点赞 means "I salute you".

column4: 这个手机的电池不太好。
column5: The battery of this phone is not very good.
column6: 电池 is a battery. 池 is read chí here.

column4: 他骑电动车上班。
column5: He rides an electric bike to work.
column6: 电动 comes before a noun: 电动车 (an electric bike or car), 电动玩具.

column4: 这家商店卖各种电器。
column5: This shop sells all kinds of electrical appliances.
column6: 电器 is a machine that uses electricity at home, such as 冰箱 (a fridge) or a TV.

column4: 他在一家电商公司工作。
column5: He works at an e-commerce company.
column6: 电商 is short for 电子商务. It means selling and buying on the internet, or a company that does so.

column4: 他在电视台工作。
column5: He works at a TV station.
column6: 电视台 is a TV station. 台 means a station or a stage.

column4: 这本书有电子版吗？
column5: Is there an electronic version of this book?
column6: 电子版 is the version you read on a screen. 版 means an edition or a version.

column4: 他被调到了别的城市工作。
column5: He was transferred to work in another city.
column6: 调 is read diào here: to transfer someone (调动) or to investigate (调查). It is read tiáo in 调整 (to adjust) and 空调 (air conditioning).

column3: to do field research; to investigate
column4: 他们去农村调研了一个星期。
column5: They went to the countryside for a week to do research.
column6: 调研 is short for 调查研究: to go to a place and study a topic on the spot.

column4: 你应该定期检查身体。
column5: You should have regular check-ups.
column6: 定期 means at fixed times, such as every week or every year. It comes before a verb: 定期检查.

column4: 如果护照丢失了，要马上报警。
column5: If your passport is lost, you must call the police at once.
column6: 丢失 is a formal word for things that go missing. The everyday word is 丢.

column4: 昨天晚上很冷，外面的水都冻住了。
column5: It was very cold last night, and the water outside all froze.
column6: 冻 is to turn into ice or to feel very cold: 冻住 (to freeze solid), 手冻了 (hands are frozen).

column4: 墙上有一个洞。
column5: There is a hole in the wall.
column6: 洞 is a hole or a cave. 山洞 is a cave and 洞口 is the mouth of a hole.

column4: 孩子们都喜欢看动画。
column5: Children all like watching cartoons.
column6: 动画 is an animated film or show. 动画片 is the longer form.

column4: 这个故事很动人。
column5: This story is very moving.
column6: 动人 is for something that touches your heart (a story, a song, a smile) or is charming.

column3: to do it yourself; to get started; to start hitting
column4: 你自己动手做一做，就会知道。
column5: Try doing it yourself, and you will know.
column6: 动手 is to start doing something with your hands: 动手做. It can also mean to start hitting someone.

column4: 我很喜欢吃豆腐。
column5: I like eating tofu very much.
column6: 豆腐 is read dòufu, with a neutral second syllable. It is made from soya beans.

column4: 他早上常常喝一杯豆浆。
column5: He often drinks a glass of soy milk in the morning.
column6: 豆浆 is a common breakfast drink in China, often with 包子.

column4: 孩子长大以后要学会独立。
column5: When children grow up, they must learn to be independent.
column6: 独立 is to stand on your own and not depend on others: 独立生活 (to live independently). A country can also become 独立.

column4: 这个城市有独特的风景。
column5: This city has unique scenery.
column6: 独特 is special in a way that nothing else is: 独特的味道 (a unique taste).

column4: 这个字的读音很难。
column5: The pronunciation of this character is very hard.
column6: 读音 is how a character or word is read aloud. One character can have two 读音, like 重.

column4: 她独自一个人去了国外。
column5: She went abroad all by herself.
column6: 独自 means all by yourself, often with a feeling of being alone: 独自生活.

column4: 下雪以后，路上堵得很厉害。
column5: After the snow, the road is badly congested.
column6: 堵 is to block a hole or a road. 堵车 is a traffic jam.

column4: 今天很冷，只有三度。
column5: Today is very cold, only three degrees.
column6: 度 is the measure word for degrees: 二十度. It is also in 温度 (temperature) and 度假 (to spend a holiday).

column4: 每个人都有自己的短处。
column5: Everyone has weaknesses of their own.
column6: 短处 is a weak point. Its opposite is 长处 (strength).

column4: 他只想在这里短期工作。
column5: He only wants to work here for a short time.
column6: 短期 is a short period. Its opposite is 长期. It comes before a noun: 短期计划.

column3: to break; to cut off; to stop
column4: 电话突然断了。
column5: The phone call was suddenly cut off.
column6: 断 is for something long that breaks or stops: 断了 (broke), 断电 (a power cut).

column4: 桌子上堆了很多书。
column5: Many books are piled up on the table.
column6: 堆 is to heap things up. It is also a noun and a measure word: 一堆书 (a pile of books).

column4: 这两张照片的对比很明显。
column5: The contrast between these two photos is very clear.
column6: 对比 is to put two things side by side to see the difference. It is also a noun.

column4: 你要认真对待这次考试。
column5: You must treat this exam seriously.
column6: 对待 is the attitude you take towards a person or matter: 对待朋友, 认真对待.

column4: 他的对手比他强得多。
column5: His opponent is much stronger than he is.
column6: 对手 is the person or team you compete against in a game or business.

column4: 买票的队伍很长。
column5: The line for tickets is very long.
column6: 队伍 is a group of people in order: a sports team, an army or a line. 排队 means "to queue".

column4: 这本书的读者对象是小学生。
column5: The target readers of this book are primary school students.
column6: 对象 is the person or thing an action is aimed at. In speech it also means a boyfriend or girlfriend: 找对象.

column4: 这辆车可以运五吨东西。
column5: This lorry can carry five tonnes of goods.
column6: 吨 is a metric tonne (1,000 kilograms). It is a measure word: 五吨.

column3: measure word for flowers and clouds
column4: 我送给她一朵花。
column5: I gave her a flower.
column6: 朵 counts flowers and clouds: 一朵花, 一朵云.

column4: 孩子们躲在门后面。
column5: The children are hiding behind the door.
column6: 躲 is to hide yourself or to avoid something: 躲雨 (to shelter from rain), 躲开 (to dodge). 藏 hides a thing away.
